headline: CoStar Q3 EBITDA Doubles Despite Soft Bookings
summary: CoStar reported that adjusted EBITDA doubled in the third quarter of 2026, though softer net new bookings weighed on company projections.
why: CoStar Group is a leading provider of commercial real estate information, analytics, and online marketplaces.

impacts.name: CoStar Group, Inc.
impacts.why: Strong EBITDA growth was tempered by signs of decelerating commercial real estate bookings.
